QUOTE: Option A, compile time (no runtime pointer, no setter): ... `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO` ... "The runtime setter is not compiled." ... "In this mode `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free` is not declared, so calling it is a compile error."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer distinguishes the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer setter. It also says the setter is not compiled when the macros are defined, which states that the two are mutually exclusive.
